inherits: C034 affine and bounded cross-class composition
theorems: For every satisfiable Horn formula, every affine GF(2) consequence is generated by forced literals and pairwise equalities.
The affine hull of a Horn model relation has a proof-carrying basis of at most n forced-literal and equality rows.
MODELS(HORN) subseteq MODELS(AFFINE) is completely decidable in polynomial time with either row-span provenance or an explicit Horn model violating one affine row.
Injecting the complete Horn affine-hull basis exhausts unconditional affine consequence exchange; a remaining fixpoint is still not compatibility.

proof_core.horn_closure: Horn models form a meet semilattice under coordinatewise conjunction.
proof_core.characters: Nonzero coordinate functions and the constant-one function are multiplicative semilattice characters.
proof_core.independence: Distinct nonzero semigroup characters into GF(2) are linearly independent by the Dedekind-Artin minimal-relation argument.
proof_core.corollary: Affine dependencies can only arise from zero coordinates, constant-one coordinates, or duplicate coordinate characters.

bounds.certificate_volume: polynomial in n, m, source size, and native proof traces
